items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest Q on the slate, impacting Justin Herbert and many projections; game at 4pm ET. Practiced limited Friday.
items.why: Rib injury; limited practice Friday after earlier absences; biggest slate uncertainty per Levitan.
items.implication: If out, Herbert projections drop; Johnston/others rise. Monitor closely.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston route/target expansion if McConkey sits.

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT (hamstring) for Week 2 vs CIN after missing practice; confirmed across reports.
items.why: Hamstring injury from Wednesday practice; no Friday participation; Grade 1 strain notes.
items.implication: Major WR1 absence for HOU; targets redistribute to Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel/Schultz.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for HOU secondary pass-catchers and TE Dalton Schultz.

items.text: Brock Bowers OUT/DOUBTFUL (knee) for Week 2 vs LAC after return to practice but pregame decision expected; unlikely to play.
items.why: Post-meniscus cleanup; practiced Friday in sleeve but coach lists doubtful, pregame workout.
items.implication: Michael Mayer remains primary TE; LV pass game without top weapon.
items.opportunity: Mayer routes/targets; potential Jeanty receiving bump in Kubiak scheme.

items.text: Zay Flowers listed doubtful (hamstring) for Sunday vs NO; second straight limited/missed practices.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP Thursday, limited/doubtful Friday; Ja'Kobi Lane also out.
items.implication: BAL WR room thins to Bateman/Walker/Wester crumbs; Andrews target bump likely.
items.opportunity: Elevated snap/route share for remaining BAL WRs and Mark Andrews.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN and ready; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown on IR. Potential 10+ touches in 2026 debut vs favorable stretch of matchups.
items.why: Full participant; self-reported ready; AJ Brown IR creates need for explosives.
items.implication: Committee with Stevenson but high upside for touches/carries in debut; nice upcoming schedule.
items.opportunity: 10+ touch potential; goal-line/third-down share vs Stevenson.
items.conflict: Unclear exact split vs Rhamondre Stevenson.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey getting bump off Week 1 usage regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) status matters for committee.
items.why: Strong Week 1 usage; Black questionable impacts depth.
items.implication: CMC volume floor raised; monitor Black for any split.

items.text: Joe Burrow listed questionable (back) but said he's playing for Sunday at HOU.
items.why: Back injury; self-stated playing; listed Q on report.
items.implication: Start with confidence; CIN offense intact barring late change.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE vs IND: 74% snap rate, 21/24 RB touches through 3Q, 40% route targets (team lead) in Week 1; IND just allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 utilization (24% tgt share) + soft matchup.
items.implication: Must-start RB1 with massive season range of outcomes.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry share continuing; IND run defense soft.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: 99 Utilization Score Week 1 (tied Bijan lead); 19% tgt share recent; 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
items.why: Kubiak scheme unlock; overreaction to injury scare unwarranted.
items.implication: RB1 upside locked in; start confidently.
items.opportunity: Near-100 util; high touches/routes in pass-heavy potential.

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz Week 1; 93 rec yds/18 PPG avg in 6 career Wentz games; CHI D soft vs WRs.
items.why: Volume with Wentz + matchup; Wentz starting confirmed.
items.opportunity: High target share continuing with Wentz.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE: career-high 26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell by 8; CLE allowed 121 rush yds/4.8 YPC.
items.why: RB9 util Week 1 + favorable matchup and clear lead role.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: 27% tgt share, 13.7 aDOT, 3 deep looks Week 1; TEN allows high catch rate/YPR and 6th-most PPG to WRs.
items.why: Strong usage + soft secondary matchup after tough Week 1.
items.opportunity: aDOT and target volume vs vulnerable TEN D.

items.text: Dak Prescott LOVE vs WAS: 21.3 PPG home last year; WAS torched for 14.5 YPC/3 TDs Week 1; DAL top-5 implied total in high-total game.
items.why: Smash spot despite Week 1; home/high total.
items.opportunity: High pass volume/implied points vs weak WAS secondary.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL: matched Kendre Miller rushes Week 1, most points via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role; underdog script vs BAL.
items.why: Committee squeeze with Kamara IN + poor script.
